hold_reason: Refund for order 255 (12535 cents) was requested in this batch but is absent from the refunds table. list_refunds shows only order 250 (14546) and order 251 (1481). W2's handoff also reports only those two as applied. Paying now could overpay customers, so no payouts have been recorded. Needs review of whether the order 255 refund was applied before payouts proceed.
